mapper.select: SELECT #{asOf} AS as_of, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN due_at < #{asOf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' AND due_at < #{asOf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_overdue_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND due_at < #{asOf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_progress_overdue_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND due_at < #{asOf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awaiting_acceptance_overdue_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS without_deadline_count FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE')
